sentences.text: À l'usine, Paul forme chaque apprenant à utiliser la presse en toute sécurité.
sentences.en: At the factory, Paul trains each learner to use the press safely.

sentences.text: À la mairie, Émilie organise des cours de français pour chaque apprenant adulte.
sentences.en: At the town hall, Émilie organises French classes for every adult learner.

sentences.text: Paul participe à la rédaction du nouveau manuel de sécurité.
sentences.en: Paul helps draft the new safety manual.
sentences.ko: 폴은 새 안전 수칙서를 쓰는 일에 참여해요.

sentences.text: Émilie s'occupe de la rédaction du journal municipal.
sentences.en: Émilie is in charge of writing the municipal newsletter.

sentences.en: The form has a cross-reference to a page that Émilie can't find.

sentences.text: Paul surveille le chargement des caisses depuis la plateforme du quai.
sentences.en: Paul watches the crates being loaded from the dock platform.
sentences.ko: 폴은 하역장 플랫폼에서 상자 싣는 걸 지켜봐요.

sentences.text: Émilie aide les habitants à utiliser la plateforme en ligne de la mairie.

sentences.en: The spare parts are stored in the annex at the back of the yard, where Paul goes to fetch them.
sentences.ko: 예비 부품은 마당 끝 별관에 있어서 폴이 가지러 가요.

sentences.text: Le service d'Émilie déménage dans l'annexe de la mairie.
sentences.en: Émilie's department is moving into the town hall annex.
sentences.ko: 에밀리의 부서가 시청 별관으로 옮겨요.

sentences.en: The factory nurse has to give first aid to Paul, who has cut himself.
sentences.ko: 공장 간호사가 손을 벤 폴에게 응급 처치를 해야 해요.

sentences.text: Émilie aide le maire à administrer le budget des écoles.
sentences.en: Émilie helps the mayor manage the schools' budget.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 시장이 학교 예산을 관리하는 걸 도와요.

sentences.text: Après des années de labeur, Paul pense enfin à la retraite.
sentences.en: After years of toil, Paul is finally thinking about retirement.
sentences.ko: 오랜 세월 고되게 일한 폴은 이제 은퇴를 생각해요.

sentences.ko: 에밀리에게 선거 준비는 정말 고된 일이에요.

sentences.text: Le fils de Paul étudie dans un lycée avec internat, loin de l'usine.

sentences.en: Émilie spent three years at boarding school before working at the town hall.

sentences.en: To ease tired backs, the factory brings in a masseur whom Paul loves.
sentences.ko: 공장이 지친 허리를 풀어 주려고 안마사를 부르는데, 폴은 아주 좋아해요.

sentences.ko: 한 안마사가 가게를 열려고 에밀리에게 허가를 받으러 와요.

sentences.en: Paul receives an allowance for night hours.
sentences.ko: 폴은 야간 근무 수당을 받아요.

sentences.en: Émilie explains to a lady how to claim compensation after the flood.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 한 부인에게 홍수 뒤 보상금을 신청하는 방법을 알려 줘요.

sentences.en: The town hall is looking for a night guard for the village hall, and Émilie posts the ad.
sentences.ko: 시청이 마을 회관 야간 경비원을 구해서 에밀리가 공고를 올려요.

sentences.ko: 초과 근무를 보상받아 폴은 사흘을 쉬게 돼요.

sentences.en: The local residents ask for compensation for the roadworks, and Émilie writes down their names.
sentences.ko: 주민들이 공사 보상을 요구해서 에밀리가 이름을 적어요.

sentences.text: Avant l'usine, Paul rêvait de faire du journalisme sportif.
sentences.en: Before the factory, Paul dreamed of working in sports journalism.
sentences.ko: 공장에 오기 전 폴은 스포츠 기자를 꿈꿨어요.

sentences.text: Émilie a étudié le journalisme avant de devenir chargée de communication.
sentences.en: Émilie studied journalism before becoming a communications officer.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 홍보 담당이 되기 전에 언론학을 공부했어요.

sentences.text: Paul doit mémoriser le code de sécurité de la nouvelle machine.
sentences.en: Paul has to memorise the security code for the new machine.
sentences.ko: 폴은 새 기계의 보안 번호를 외워야 해요.

sentences.en: Émilie has to memorise the names of all the town councillors.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 시의원 이름을 모두 외워야 해요.

sentences.ko: 공장이 폴의 작업장을 현대화할 보조금을 받았어요.

sentences.en: Every box carries a coded number that Paul scans at the exit.

sentences.ko: 에밀리는 기록 보관실을 열려고 암호화된 출입 번호를 눌러요.

sentences.text: Une classe d'écoliers visite l'usine, et Paul leur montre la chaîne de montage.
sentences.en: A class of schoolchildren visits the factory, and Paul shows them the assembly line.
sentences.ko: 초등학생 한 반이 공장을 견학하고, 폴이 조립 라인을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Un écolier pose à Émilie des questions sur le travail du maire.
sentences.en: A schoolboy asks Émilie questions about the mayor's job.
sentences.ko: 한 초등학생이 에밀리에게 시장이 하는 일을 물어요.

sentences.en: Paul is covering for a sick colleague this week.

sentences.ko: 에밀리는 광장의 낡은 가로등 교체를 맡아요.

sentences.en: Paul's neighbour is a composer and comes to record the noises of the factory.
sentences.ko: 폴의 이웃은 작곡가라서 공장 소리를 녹음하러 와요.

sentences.en: Paul is waiting for his badge to be activated to enter the new workshop.
sentences.ko: 폴은 새 작업장에 들어가려고 출입증이 활성화되기를 기다려요.

sentences.ko: 에밀리는 주민들에게 시민 계정 활성화 링크를 보내요.

sentences.text: L'expérience de Paul est inestimable pour les jeunes ouvriers.

sentences.en: The town hall's old registers are of priceless value, according to Émilie.

sentences.en: The two neighbouring villages want to merge, and Émilie prepares the vote.

sentences.en: Paul celebrates his ninth year with the company with a cake.

sentences.text: C'est la neuvième fois qu'Émilie organise le marché de Noël.
sentences.en: This is the ninth time Émilie has organised the Christmas market.
sentences.ko: 에밀리가 크리스마스 장터를 여는 건 이번이 아홉 번째예요.

sentences.text: Le nouvel apprenti est un piètre bricoleur, mais Paul reste patient.

sentences.en: Émilie shows visitors round the wedding hall, whose splendour impresses the tourists.

sentences.text: Paul n'est pas aisé, mais il a payé la maison avec son salaire de l'usine.

sentences.en: The town's well-off neighbourhood asks Émilie for more cycle lanes.

sentences.text: Un livreur malpoli klaxonne devant le portail, et Paul va lui parler.

sentences.ko: 무례한 배달 기사가 정문 앞에서 경적을 울리자 폴이 말하러 가요.

sentences.text: Le soir, Paul écoute une fugue de Bach pour oublier le bruit des machines.
sentences.en: In the evening, Paul listens to a Bach fugue to forget the noise of the machines.
sentences.ko: 저녁에 폴은 기계 소음을 잊으려고 바흐의 푸가를 들어요.

sentences.en: Émilie helps the parents of a runaway teenager contact the right services.

sentences.en: The team leader threatens to confiscate phones, and Paul finds that excessive.
sentences.ko: 팀장이 휴대폰을 압수하겠다고 하자 폴은 지나치다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Paul trouve le chiffre de production un peu trompeur, car une machine était en panne.

sentences.en: Émilie finds the article's headline misleading and asks the paper to correct it.

sentences.text: Le déménagement de la grosse presse a été une aventure épique pour Paul et son équipe.
sentences.en: Moving the big press was an epic adventure for Paul and his team.
sentences.ko: 큰 프레스를 옮긴 일은 폴과 팀에게 대단한 모험이었어요.

sentences.text: Le débat sur le nouveau parking a été épique, raconte Émilie en riant.
sentences.en: The debate about the new car park was epic, Émilie says with a laugh.
sentences.ko: 새 주차장을 두고 벌어진 토론은 정말 대단했다고 에밀리가 웃으며 말해요.

sentences.text: Paul défend un emballage plus durable pour réduire les déchets.
sentences.en: Paul argues for more sustainable packaging to reduce waste.
sentences.ko: 폴은 쓰레기를 줄이려고 더 오래 쓰는 포장재를 주장해요.
